mapper.select: SELECT k.id AS knowledge_base_id,d.id AS document_id,d.active_version_id, v.id AS version_id,v.document_id AS version_document_id FROM knowledge_base k LEFT JOIN document d ON d.knowledge_base_id=k.id AND d.active_version_id IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN document_index_version v ON v.id=d.active_version_id WHERE k.id=#{kbId} ORDER BY d.id
